🔗 How to add Fireflies links

Each session needs its Fireflies URL so the recording, transcript, summary, and chapters can load directly here.

  1. Click Edit Links at the top right of this page
  2. Open app.fireflies.ai in another tab and find the training recording
  3. Click the Share button → go to the Embed tab
  4. Click Copy Embed Code — this copies the full <iframe ...> tag
  5. Paste it into the embed field on the matching session card → click Save

Links are saved in your browser and will still be here next time you open this file. The page automatically extracts the embed URL from the pasted iframe code.
